cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked how lunch was. Excellent soup. I helped myself to cake when you took a piece.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took a crumb to test whether it was baked. Did you cut into the birthday cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, checking the texture. The soup had plenty of pepper, since you asked about the food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There should be twelve slices. How many did you eat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough pepper to warm you up, but not so much you lose the carrot. That's what made lunch good.

reason: Ground the copied confidence in a specific misunderstood act and make it alter the exact Drive pursuit, with a final response based on B4 rather than an abstract mechanism summary.
